Navigate to the Ben & Jerry's online flavor graveyard.
Agents:
- Agent: WebServing_Expert
  -- Action: Reviewed the task, acknowledged need to double-check, and navigated to the Flavor Graveyard URL.
  -- Observation: Loaded the Flavor Graveyard landing page (page 1 of 6) and saw site navigation and initial flavor entries (e.g., Aloha Macadamia, Bovinity Divinity).
  -- Thought: Follow the manager’s plan by first accessing the official Flavor Graveyard to gather authoritative data.
  -- Result: Provided the Flavor Graveyard page content and confirmed access to the correct resource (Address: https://www.benjerry.com/flavors/flavor-graveyard).
Data_Flow:
- from_step: 1
  to_step: 1
  source_agent: WebServing_Expert
  target_agent: WebServing_Expert
  data_item: "Flavor Graveyard URL (https://www.benjerry.com/flavors/flavor-graveyard)"
  data_type: "text"
  transformation: "Direct navigation to resource"
  correctness: "correct"
  confidence: 0.95

Identify the oldest flavor's headstone in the graveyard.
Agents:
- Agent: WebServing_Expert
  -- Action: Continued browsing the Flavor Graveyard (page 2 of 6) to list additional entries.
  -- Observation: Found the Dastardly Mash entry with dates 1979-1991 and its epitaph, plus other flavors on the same page.
  -- Thought: Dastardly Mash appears to be the oldest flavor listed (1979 start date).
  -- Result: Identified Dastardly Mash as the oldest flavor and provided its entry (including image link and epitaph).
Data_Flow:
- from_step: 2
  to_step: 2
  source_agent: WebServing_Expert
  target_agent: WebServing_Expert
  data_item: "Dastardly Mash entry (1979-1991) with epitaph and image link"
  data_type: "text"
  transformation: "Content extraction from page 2"
  correctness: "correct"
  confidence: 0.9

Examine the photo of the headstone and locate the headstone visible in the background.
Agents:
- Agent: WebServing_Expert
  -- Action: Referred to the Dastardly Mash headstone image and nearby entries on the same page.
  -- Observation: The page includes the Dastardly Mash tombstone image and the Crème Brulee entry with its epitaph; agent infers the background headstone in the Dastardly Mash photo is Crème Brulee.
  -- Thought: By inspecting the provided image/context, identify the background headstone as Crème Brulee.
  -- Result: Concluded the background headstone visible in the Dastardly Mash photo is Crème Brulee.
Data_Flow:
- from_step: 2
  to_step: 3
  source_agent: WebServing_Expert
  target_agent: WebServing_Expert
  data_item: "Dastardly Mash tombstone image context and adjacent entries"
  data_type: "text"
  transformation: "Visual/contextual inference to identify background headstone"
  correctness: "correct"
  confidence: 0.65

Read the rhyme under the flavor name on the background headstone and extract the last line of the rhyme.
Agents:
- Agent: WebServing_Expert
  -- Action: Provided the Crème Brulee epitaph text from the Flavor Graveyard page where Dastardly Mash appears.
  -- Observation: Crème Brulee epitaph lines include: 'Pardon our French, ... beyond compare, So it may not be beaucoup ... Crème Brulee from beyond the grave.'
  -- Thought: Use the Crème Brulee epitaph to determine the last line.
  -- Result: Supplied the text needed to extract the final line of the rhyme.
- Agent: BenAndJerrysFlavors_Expert
  -- Action: Asserted the last line of the background headstone’s rhyme.
  -- Observation: Identified the background headstone as Crème Brulee and referenced its epitaph.
  -- Thought: Interpreted the final portion of the epitaph as a single sentence.
  -- Result: Claimed the last line as: "So it may not be beaucoup too late to save Crème Brulee from beyond the grave."
- Agent: DataVerification_Expert
  -- Action: Reviewed and agreed with the asserted last line.
  -- Observation: No new data produced; aligned with the prior claim.
  -- Thought: Considered the assertion sufficiently verified.
  -- Result: Confirmed the same last-line text and proposed concluding.
Data_Flow:

  to_step: 3
  source_agent: WebServing_Expert
  target_agent: WebServing_Expert
  data_item: "Crème Brulee epitaph lines"
  data_type: "text"
  transformation: "Selection and reinterpretation of multiple lines as a 'last line'"

The Subtask Name: Navigate to the Ben & Jerry’s Flavor Graveyard
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: WebServing_Expert
  To_agent: WebServing_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: reasoning_continuation
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: The agent continues pagination and data collection from the Flavor Graveyard across step 0 (page 1) and step 1 (page 2), maintaining context to locate relevant flavor entries.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: The agent could get stuck paginating without consolidating findings.
      severity: 0.40
      if_from_agent_wrong: It may keep fetching pages without summarizing or identifying target items.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The continuation of reasoning will be misdirected, delaying identification of the target flavor.
    - type: data_issue
      description: Misparsing or misreading flavor entries and epitaphs on the pages.
      severity: 0.55
      if_from_agent_wrong: Incorrect extraction of flavor years or text could occur.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Subsequent reasoning may rest on inaccurate flavor identification or mislabeled details.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Missing the oldest flavor entry during pagination.
      severity: 0.30
      if_from_agent_wrong: The agent may not identify Dastardly Mash as the oldest flavor.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Later steps may focus on the wrong target, making accurate downstream verification harder.

The Subtask Name: Identify the oldest flavor and infer background headstone
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: WebServing_Expert
  To_agent: WebServing_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.78
  agent_explanation: Using observations from step 1 (which includes the Dastardly Mash entry), the agent decides in step 2 to infer which background headstone appears and what its last line is.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: Misidentifying the background headstone in the image or misquoting the epitaph’s last line.
      severity: 0.62
      if_from_agent_wrong: The selected background headstone may be incorrect, and the quoted last line may be inaccurate.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Decisions based on this inference will propagate a wrong conclusion until verification corrects it.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Concluding definitively without sufficient image verification.
      severity: 0.35
      if_from_agent_wrong: A firm but incorrect conclusion may bias later agents.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Downstream agents could accept the claim and be less likely to re-check, risking final answer accuracy.

The Subtask Name: Execute and review Bing web search
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: DataVerification_Expert
  To_agent: Computer_terminal
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.90
  agent_explanation: In step 3, the DataVerification_Expert decides to run a Bing search and instructs the Computer_terminal to execute code to retrieve supporting evidence.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: Poorly formed query or reliance on a failing function returning None.
      severity: 0.58
      if_from_agent_wrong: The search may fail or return irrelevant results.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Computer_terminal may produce errors or unhelpful outputs, hindering verification.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Depending solely on the failed API response without alternative methods.
      severity: 0.42
      if_from_agent_wrong: No usable data will be captured.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The execution path stalls, forcing ad hoc decisions or assumptions.
- From_agent: Computer_terminal
  To_agent: DataVerification_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: obs_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.83
  agent_explanation: In step 4, the Computer_terminal provides search outputs and an error trace, which the DataVerification_Expert needs to interpret and use for next steps.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: Returning partial results alongside an execution error that can be misinterpreted.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: The terminal output may conflate error states with valid results.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The DataVerification_Expert may incorrectly assume verification succeeded or overlook viable manual review paths.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If outputs are too sparse or malformed to guide verification.
      severity: 0.38
      if_from_agent_wrong: The expert lacks actionable data for confirmation.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Verification may halt or rely on previously unverified claims.

The Subtask Name: Manual verification and consensus
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: BenAndJerrysFlavors_Expert
  To_agent: DataVerification_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.75

      description: Manual inspection error leading to an incorrect last line or misidentified background headstone.

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The DataVerification_Expert would validate and endorse a faulty claim, compromising the final answer.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Consensus formed prematurely without independent cross-checks.
      severity: 0.40
      if_from_agent_wrong: Incorrect consensus becomes entrenched.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Later correction becomes unlikely, as agreement reduces scrutiny.
- From_agent: DataVerification_Expert

  agent_dependency_type: loop_control
  agent_strength: 0.70
  agent_explanation: In step 6, the DataVerification_Expert signals readiness to terminate based on agreement; in step 7, the BenAndJerrysFlavors_Expert echoes termination, closing the loop.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Premature termination without addressing lingering uncertainties or alternate validation.
      severity: 0.50
      if_from_agent_wrong: The process may end before resolving potential discrepancies.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The receiving agent will finalize and stop further inquiry, risking unresolved errors.
